title: 'Strategic investigation' leads to drugs, weapons bust in Prince George - NewsBreak
text:
By Bill Atkinson ,
3 hours ago Two men are in police custody in Prince George County after they were caught with marijuana, narcotics and a large amount of cash.
According to a March 11 announcement from Prince George Police, the arrests stemmed from a “strategic investigation” that led to a search warrant execution. In the process, authorities seized three firearms, four ounces of pot, more than an ounce of powdered cocaine and $12,090 in currency.
The suspects were identified as Tyrese D’on Hawkins, 25, and Kyi Demon Rhodes, 27, both of North Dinwiddie County. Both individuals are currently being held on multiple felony counts, including:
Distribution of a more than an ounce of Schedule I/II Substance; Possession of a Firearm by a Convicted Violent Felon; and Possession of a Firearm while in Possession of a Schedule I/II Substance. "The removal of illegal narcotics and firearms from our streets is a testament to the department's commitment to public safety," PGPD Major James Nicholas said in a statement. "We remain dedicated to disrupting criminal activity and ensuring that those who repeatedly violate the law are held accountable."
The suspects are being held at Meherrin River Regional Jail in Brunswick County.
Bill Atkinson (he/him/his) is an award-winning journalist who covers breaking news, government and politics. Reach him at batkinson@progress-index.com or on X (formerly known as Twitter) at @BAtkinson_PI.
